lots.key_photo_findings: Enlarged crop of photo 6 reads 'LITHOGRAPHED & PUBLISHED BY STRINGER, MASON & Co MELBOURNE' and 'St FRANCIS CATHEDRAL' with a faint '...LBOURNE' below. Hand tinting looks soft and even and the paper is toned, which fits a period print, but that is not proof. Stringer, Mason & Co traded only about Oct 1853 to May 1854, so a genuine impression would be an early and scarce Melbourne view and the only piece here of interest. The rest are amateur watercolours and reproductions; the unframed watercolours have creased, chipped edges.
